alabandos: alabar + se — boasting (of themselves) (gerund alabando + enclitic se, -se reduced to -s as in tornós; Alabandos ivan 'they went about boasting'; ir + gerund; = alabándose)
alabándos: alabar + se — boasting (gerund + enclitic se reduced to -s; Alabándos se[d]ían 'they were boasting'; = alabándose)
sedían: seer — they were (imperfect 3rd pl., -ía ending, Pidal's restoration se[d]ían; seer + gerund, 'were (busy) doing': Alabándos sedían 'they were boasting'; = estaban, eran)
diré: dezir — I shall tell (future 1st sg., contracted dir-é; yo vos diré 'I shall tell you'; = diré)
mandáronle: mandar + le — they ordered him (preterite 3rd pl. + enclitic dative le; mandáronle ir adelante 'they ordered him to go on ahead'; = le mandaron)
doliól: doler + le — it pained him; doliól el coraçón 'his heart misgave him' (preterite 3rd sg. dolió + enclitic le reduced to -l; Pidal 'le dió una corazonada, tuvo un presentimiento'; = le dolió)
espesso: espesso — thick, dense (adj. masc. sg., ss spelling; un monte espesso 'a thick wood'; = espeso)
primas: prima — cousin (fem. pl.; sus primas 'his cousins'; = primas)
víolos: ver + los — he saw them (preterite 3rd sg. vío + enclitic los; Víolos venir 'he saw them coming'; = los vio)
vidien: ver — they saw, were seeing (imperfect 3rd pl., -ie ending, printed unaccented, Pidal's vi[di]en; ellos nol vidien 'they did not see him'; = veían)
sabien: saber — they knew (imperfect 3rd pl., -ie ending, printed unaccented; ni dend sabien ración 'nor knew anything of it'; = sabían)
ración: ración — portion, share (fem.; ni dend sabien ración 'nor did they know any part of it', i.e. nothing at all; sense from context, Pidal gives no note; = ración, here nada)
vidiessen: ver — they might see (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl., Pidal's vi[d]iessen; si ellos le vidiessen 'if they had seen him'; = viesen)
escapara: escapar — he would have escaped (3rd sg. -ra form, here with pluperfect-indicative / conditional sense, apodosis after si ... vidiessen; non escapara de muort 'he would not have escaped death'; = habría escapado)
amorteçidas: amorteçer — in a faint, swooned (past part. fem. pl., agreeing with primas; amorteçidas amas a dos 'both in a faint'; = amortecidas, desmayadas)
descavalgó: descavalgar — he dismounted (preterite 3rd sg.; luego descavalgó 'at once he got down'; = descabalgó)
arrendó: arrendar — he tied (a horse) by the rein (preterite 3rd sg.; arrendó el cavallo 'he tied up the horse', Pidal 'lo ató por la rienda'; = ató por la rienda)
ensayaron: ensayar + se — they exerted themselves, did a feat (preterite 3rd pl. with reflexive se; mal se ensayaron 'an evil feat they did', Pidal 'mala proeza hicieron', cf. ensayarse v. 2388; = se esforzaron)
valas: ir + las — he goes (…ing) them (present 3rd sg. va + enclitic object las; ir + gerund; Valas tornando 'he goes on bringing them round', Pidal 'las va haciendo volver en su acuerdo'; Valas conortando 'he goes on comforting them'; = las va)
traspuestas: traspuesto — overcome, in a swoon (past part. fem. pl. of trasponer, used as adjective; tanto son de traspuestas 'so far gone are they'; sense from context; = traspuestas)
puoden: poder — they can (present 3rd pl., Pidal's pu[o]den with the diphthong; nada dezir non puoden 'they cannot say anything'; = pueden)
partiéronsele: partir + se + le — were broken (for him) (preterite 3rd pl. + reflexive/passive se + dative le; Partiéronsele las telas 'the membranes of his heart were rent'; = se le partieron)
despertedes: despertar — wake up! (present subjunctive 2nd pl., old -edes ending, used as exhortation; Despertedes, primas 'wake, cousins'; = despertéis, here despertad)
coman: comer — let them eat, lest they eat (present subjunctive 3rd pl.; non nos coman 'let them not eat us'; = coman)
recordando: recordar — waking up, coming to (gerund; Van recordando 'they are coming to'; = despertando, recobrando el sentido)
esforçadvos: esforçar + vos — take heart (imperative 2nd pl. + enclitic vos, -d- kept; Esforçadvos, primas 'take heart, cousins'; = esforzaos)
fallaren: fallar — they find (future subjunctive 3rd pl.; de que non me fallaren 'when they do not find me'; = hallaren)
morremos: morir — we shall die (future 1st pl., syncopated stem morr-; aquí morremos nos 'here we shall die'; = moriremos)
dandos: dar + nos — give us (imperative 2nd pl. dad + nos, with metathesis dadnos > dandos; dandos del agua 'give us some water'; = dadnos)
sombrero: sombrero — hat (masc.; un sombrero 'a hat'; = sombrero)
nuevo: nuevo — new (masc. sg.; nuevo era e fresco 'it was new and fresh'; = nuevo)
fresco: fresco — fresh, clean (masc. sg.; nuevo era e fresco 'new it was, and fresh'; = fresco)
valençial: Valençia + l — Valençia + the object pronoun cut to -l (le, or lo; 'it', the hat, repeating the relative que); que de Valençial sacó 'which he had brought out of Valencia' (preterite sacó, pluperfect sense; = que lo sacó de Valencia)
cogió: coger — he scooped up, gathered (preterite 3rd sg.; cogió del agua 'he took up some water'; = cogió)
lazradas: lazrar — suffering, worn out (past part. fem. pl. used as adjective; mucho son lazradas 'they are greatly worn out'; cf. lacerado; = laceradas, here agotadas)
fartó: fartar — he satisfied, gave their fill (preterite 3rd sg.; amas las fartó 'he gave them both their fill'; = las hartó)
rogó: rogar — he begged (preterite 3rd sg.; tanto las rogó 'so much he begged them'; = rogó)
assentó: assentar — he seated (preterite 3rd sg.; fata que las assentó 'until he had seated them'; = asentó, sentó)
conortando: conortar — comforting, cheering (gerund; Valas conortando 'he went comforting them'; Pidal 'las va confortando'; = confortando, consolando)
metiendo: meter — putting in, instilling (gerund; metiendo coraçón 'putting heart into them'; = infundiendo)
esfuerçan: esforçar — they take heart, revive (present 3rd pl.; fata que esfuerçan 'until they take heart'; = se esfuerzan, cobran ánimo)
cubrió: cobrir — he covered (preterite 3rd sg., -ió; a amas las cubrió 'he covered both'; = cubrió)
partió: partir — he led away, took off (preterite 3rd sg., Pidal's parti[ó]; dent las partió 'he took them away from there'; = las apartó, se las llevó)
señeros: señero — alone, unaccompanied (masc. pl.; todos tres señeros 'all three alone'; = señeros, solos)
robredos: robredo — oak wood (masc. pl.; los robredos de Corpes 'the oak woods of Corpes'; = robledos)
arribados: arribar — arrived (past part. masc. pl., with son as auxiliary of an intransitive; ellos arribados son 'they have arrived'; = arribados, llegados)
urraca: Urraca — a woman's name (la torre de don Urraca 'Doña Urraca's tower', don before a woman's name as with don Elvira; Pidal: the tower probably stood where the place now called La Torre is, seven kilometres west of San Esteban de Gormaz, near the Llano de Urraca on the Duero)
díag: Díag — Diego (Pidal's Dí[a]g Téllez, with the restored a; = Diego)
téllez: Téllez — patronymic 'son of Tello' (Díag Téllez, a vassal of Álvar Fáñez; = Téllez)
hiva: ir — he was going (imperfect 3rd sg., h- spelling; hiva reçebir 'he went to receive'; = iba)
mesurados: mesurado — courteous, restrained, well-mannered (past part. as adj., masc. pl.; siempre mesurados son 'ever courteous are they'; = mesurados)
pesóles: pesar + les — it grieved them (preterite 3rd sg. + enclitic dative les; pesóles de coraçón 'it grieved them at heart'; = les pesó)
enffurçión: enfurçión — tribute in kind (food, grain and wine) paid by a tenant to his lord for his holding; here provisions given in hospitality (Pidal, note to v. 2822; a las fijas del Çid danles enffurçión 'they furnish the Çid's daughters with provision'; grant enffurçión 'a great store of provision'; = infurción)
sovieron: seer — they stayed (strong preterite 3rd pl. of seer 'to be, stay'; allí sovieron ellas 'there they stayed'; = estuvieron)
sabidas: saber — known (past part. fem. pl., passive with son; estas nuevas sabidas son 'these tidings are known'; = sabidas)
dada: dar — given (past part. fem. sg., agreeing with ondra; tal ondra me an dada 'such honour they have given me'; = dada)
par: por — by (par for por in an oath; par aquesta barba 'by this beard'; = por)
messó: messar — he plucked, tore at (preterite 3rd sg.; barba que nadi non messó 'beard that no one has plucked'; = mesó)
lograrán: lograr — to enjoy the fruit of, have joy of (future 3rd pl.; non la lograrán 'they shall not have joy of it', la the 'honour' (the outrage) of v. 2831; Pidal 'no lograrán el fruto de la deshonra', esto es, 'no lograrán deshonrarme'; = lograrán)
casaré: casar — I shall marry off (future 1st sg.; bien las casaré yo 'I shall marry them well'; = casaré)
quales: qual — those whom (relative, masc. pl.; dozientos cavalleros, quales mio Çid mandó 'two hundred knights, those my Çid ordered', Pidal 'los que'; = los que, cuales)
dixoles: dezir — he told them (strong preterite 3rd sg. dixo + enclitic les; dixoles fuertemientre 'he charged them strictly', Pidal 'les dijo encarecidamente'; = les dijo)
andidiessen: andar — they should travel (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl., in indirect command; que andidiessen de dia e de noch 'that they should travel day and night'; = anduviesen)
aduxiessen: aduzir — they should bring (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl., strong stem; aduxiessen a ssus fijas 'that they bring his daughters'; = trajesen; modern aducir means 'adduce')
ssus: su — his (spelling with initial double s; ssus fijas 'his daughters'; = sus)
gormaz: Gormaz — Gormaz, castle on the Duero (Pidal: its great castle is from the Arab period and was of capital importance in the tenth-century reconquest; un castiello tan fuort 'a castle so strong'; = Gormaz)
í: í — there (adverb, Latin ibi; í albergaron 'there they lodged'; = allí; survives in the 'y' of hay)
proes: pro — worthy, valiant (pl.; Pidal's pro[e]s; a guisa de muy proes 'in the manner of very worthy men'; = prohombres, de pro)
presentan: presentar — they present, offer (present 3rd pl.; presentan a Minaya grant enffurçión 'they present Minaya with great gifts of provisions'; = presentan)
gradió: gradir — he thanked (preterite 3rd sg.; mucho gelo gradió 'he thanked them much for it'; = agradeció)
coñosçedores: coñosçedor — understanding, prudent, discerning (masc. pl.; que sodes coñosçedores 'who are men of good understanding', Pidal 'entendido, prudente'; = conocedores, entendidos)
ffago: fazer — I do (present 1st sg., ff- spelling; assí lo ffago yo 'so do I'; = hago)
estó: estar — I am (present 1st sg.; aquí estó 'here I am'; = estoy)
çielos: çielo — heaven (masc. pl.; Dios de los çielos 'God of the heavens'; = cielos)
gradeçen: gradeçer — they thank (present 3rd pl.; todos gelo gradeçen 'all thank him for it'; = agradecen)
gradimos: gradir — we thank (present 1st pl.; vos lo gradimos 'we thank you for it'; = agradecemos)
viéssemos: veer — we should see (imperfect subjunctive 1st pl.; commo si viéssemos al Criador 'as if we were seeing the Creator'; = viésemos)
gradid: gradir — thank (imperative 2nd pl.; vos a él lo gradid 'you thank him for it'; = agradeced)
rencura: rencura — grievance, sorrow, complaint (fem.; toda nuestra rencura 'all our grievance'; = rencor, queja)
sabremos: saber — we shall be able, we shall know how to (future 1st pl., syncopated; sabremos contar 'we shall be able to tell'; = sabremos)

__broaden__.tornós: tornar + se — she turned back (tornó + -s(e): after a stressed vowel -se shrinks to -s) · also tornarse a + inf. 'to set to, begin' (tornós a sonrisar 'he broke into a smile', perhaps 'smiled again'; the Cid the subject) · also he turned (toward) (tornós a essa part 'he turned that way', the Cid the subject) · also tornós — he turned back (the -s from se; Por el rastro tornós Félez Muñoz 'back along the trail Félez Muñoz turned'; masc. subject, not 'she')
__broaden__.entre: entre — between, among; entre X e Y 'X and Y together' · also entre — entrar, may it enter (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; ante que entre la noch 'before night comes on'; = entre)
__broaden__.ganados: ganar — gained, earned (past part. masc. pl., agreeing with its object, as with ovo bastidos; avien ganados = habían ganado) · also ganados — gains, spoils (noun, masc. pl.; Pidal 'ganancias': los ganados que fizo 'the gains he made'; = ganancias) · also ganados — as a noun, winnings, spoils (todos los ganados 'all the booty'; Pidal's note: 'ganancias', v. 481) · also ganado — cattle, beasts (masc. noun, pl.; los ganados fieros 'the wild beasts'; noun, not the past participle; = ganados)
__broaden__.vale: valer — it is worth (present 3rd sg.; que más vale de mill marcos 'which is worth more than a thousand marks'; = vale) · also va + le — 'it goes on (…ing) for him' (ir + gerund with enclitic le: Yal creçe la barba e vale allongando 'and it goes on lengthening for him'; = se le va alargando) · also más vale que 'it is better that' (impersonal; más vale que nos los vezcamos 'better that we conquer them') · also valer — he helps, aids (present 3rd sg.; si Dios non nos vale 'if God does not help us'; = vale, here ayuda)
__broaden__.meresca: merecer — may I earn, deserve (of someone) (present subjunctive 1st sg., with -sca; aun vea el ora que vos meresca dos tanto 'may I yet see the hour when I may earn of you twice as much', i.e. repay you twice over; Pidal 'ojalá os lo pueda pagar con creces', literally 'merezca de vos el doble'; = merezca) · also meresca — 3rd sg., 'may he repay (it to you)' (sí vos lo meresca … nuestro padre 'so may our father repay you for it'; = os lo pague)
__broaden__.cavalgó: cavalgar — he rode (preterite 3rd sg.; = cabalgó) · also cavalgar — he set (them) on horseback (transitive; las cavalgó 'he mounted them'; = las montó)
__broaden__.peso: peso — weight; sin peso 'without weighing' · also peso — it grieved (preterite 3rd sg. pesó, accent unprinted; de cuer peso esto al buen rey 'this grieved the good king at heart'; = pesó)
__broaden__.tomar: tomar — to take (infinitive) · to seize, catch (en su tierra le pudies tomar 'could seize him in his land') · also tomar — to accept (non gelo quiso tomar 'he would not accept it from them'; = aceptar)
__broaden__.verdad: verdad — truth (dezir vos he la verdad 'I shall tell you the truth'; = verdad) · also non será verdad — 'it shall not be so' (Pidal: 'esto no será así'; esto non será verdad) · also por verdad — truly, indeed (í albergaron por verdad una noch 'they truly lodged there one night')
__broaden__.fincan: fincar — they stop, cease (present 3rd pl.; non fincan de andar 'they do not stop riding'; = quedan, closest cesan) · also fincar — they stay, take their stand (fincan sobre so señor 'they take their stand around their lord'; = se quedan, se plantan) · also fincar — they fix, rest (en el[le] fincan los ojos 'they fix their eyes on him'; = clavan, fijan)
__broaden__.tornando: tornar — turning (gerund; la cabeça tornando va 'he goes turning his head'; = tornando) · also tornar — bringing round, reviving (transitive, of someone in a swoon; Valas tornando a ellas 'he goes on bringing them round', Pidal 'las va haciendo volver en su acuerdo'; = reanimando)
__broaden__.mal: mal — harm, hurt, ruin · mal — evil, in the prayer's sense (por end es salvo de mal 'therefore he is saved from evil') · also mal — adverb 'sorely, ill' (por cuer le pesó mal 'it grieved him sorely at heart') · also tener a mal — 'to take amiss' (non lo tenga a mal 'let him not take it amiss') · also mal — evil, bad (adjective, apocopated malo, before a noun; mal galardón 'an evil reward'; = mal)
__broaden__.mont: Mont — mount, hill (Latin montem; = monte); Mont Mayor, the place Martín Muñoz held: Montemayor, a Portuguese town he governed for Alfonso VI, according to Pidal · also Mont Real — Monreal, name of the place above which the Cid's hill stands (Pidal: Monreal del Campo, on the Jiloca); see real · also Mont Alván — Montalbán, town in Teruel (a Mont Alván; = Montalbán) · also mont — wood, wild wooded country (apocopated monte, common noun; en aqueste mont 'in this wood'; = monte)
__broaden__.elle: elle — he (old form of él, Latin ille; elle fizo = él hizo; Pidal restores el[le]) · also el[le] after a preposition, 'it, him' (en el[le] 'in it', of the hat; en el[le] fincan los ojos 'they fix their eyes on him'; = él)
__broaden__.de: de — of, from · also de — by (the agent with a passive participle; = por) · also de — 'by (night)' (de noch), partitive 'of, among' (quinze moros … de los que alcançava; pocas de gentes), 'as' (de ganançia 'as booty'), 'from outside' (de fuera), 'on the right' (de diestro) · also 'about, concerning' (de mí non digan mal 'let them not speak ill of me') · also de — 'as if in' (commo de arrancada 'as if in rout'); 'in the manner of' (de guisa 'in such a way'); 'of, among' (de bivos pocos 'of the living few'); nominalized infinitive (del prender 'of the taking') · also de — 'with' of manner (de fuertes coraçones 'with stout hearts'); 'on' (de pie 'on foot'); 'from' of side (della e della part 'from both sides'); de cabo 'anew' (de + cabo, 'again'); de suso de 'above'; seños … de seños colpes 'with one blow each' · also de — 'in respect of' after an adjective (sobejana de mala 'exceedingly bad'); 'with regard to, about' (me plaze de mio Çid 'I am pleased about the Cid'); 'from, at the hand of' (de señor non ha graçia 'he gets no favor from a lord'); 'from' of origin (de moros fo 'it came from Moors'); 'at' of manner (de vagar 'at leisure', de + the noun vagar) · also de’ — Pidal's de’llaño, read as del llaño 'of the plain' (the article's l run into the ll; a reading, not certain) · de + infinitive after an adjective (de ir somos guisados 'we are ready to go') · also de + infinitive after a verb: començar de 'to begin to' (compeçó de fablar 'he began to speak'), piénssanse de 'set about' (piénssanse de armar), aver de 'to have to' (lo que ha de far 'what he has to do') · also de — 'within' of a time limit (De aquestos quinze días, most likely 'within these fifteen days'; sense uncertain); de veluntad 'willingly'; de + superlative partitive (de los mejores guarnimientos 'of the best equipment') · also de — 'with, from' of the means or source (diziendo de la boca 'saying with his mouth'; de cuer les pesa 'it grieves them from the heart') · also de que 'of whom, of which' (relative after a noun; de moros de que non avien sabor 'of Moors they had no taste for') · de firme 'steadfastly, with a will' (de firme robavan el campo); de + noun of material, 'in' (de plata seys çientos marcos 'six hundred marks in silver'); of possession, 'belonging to' (de vos son 'are yours'); fartos de lidiar 'sated with fighting'; pagado de 'pleased with' · also de — dé, may he give (present subjunctive 3rd sg. of dar, printed without accent; que vos de dent buen galardón 'that he may give you a good reward for it'; = dé) · also tanto … de + adjective, 'so (very)' (tanto son de traspuestas 'so far gone are they')
__broaden__.fo: seer (and ir, which shares this preterite) — he/it was; went (preterite 3rd sg.; = fue, restored by Pidal as f[o]; of this part's three occurrences, fo entrado and fo acusado are periphrastic/passive ser + past part. constructions, while fo algo is a plain copula with a pronoun predicate, 'was something') · also commo fo tu voluntad, ca fo tu voluntad 'as/for it was your will' (ser + noun subject, 'it was'; Pidal restores f[o]) · also se fo acomendar 'went to commend himself' (ir); fo de noch 'it was night' (ser de + noun, 'night had come'); fo desenparada (passive, 'was abandoned') · also fo — went (ir; mañanas fo Minaya 'in the morning Minaya went'); fo de moros 'it came from the Moors' (ser de + noun of origin; Pidal restores f[o]) · also fo — it was, ser + adjective predicate (Buena fo la de Valençia 'good was the (capture) of Valencia'; Pidal restores f[o]) · also fo — was (the man) of, belonged to (ser de of a vassal; el que de Albar Fáñez fo 'he who was Álvar Fáñez's man'; = fue)
__broaden__.fuertemientre: fuertemientre — strongly, hard, mightily (= fuertemente) · also fuertemientre — earnestly, strictly (dixoles fuertemientre 'he charged them strictly', Pidal 'les dijo encarecidamente'; = encarecidamente)
__broaden__.vala: valer — may he avail, protect (present subjunctive; vos vala 'may he keep you') · also vala — may he help (sí vos vala el Criador 'so may the Creator help you'; = ayude)
__broaden__.metió: meter — he put (preterite 3rd sg.; metió mano 'laid hand to'; = metió) · also meterse — he went into, hid himself (en un monte espesso … se metió 'he went into a thick wood'); dentro las metió 'he brought them inside'
